content.introduction: The sources indicate that markets experienced volatility this week, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index (SOX) testing support at the 200-day simple moving average. The S&P 500 companies reported strong earnings, with 61% beating on the top line and 82% on the bottom line, and year-over-year revenue growth at 13.64% and earnings-per-share growth at 29.37%. For the upcoming week, notable companies scheduled to report include Brookfield Asset Management, Enbridge Inc., Humana Inc., Moderna Inc., Plains All American Pipeline LP, PPL Corp., Vistra Corp., and Ubiquiti Inc. The Nasdaq and S&P 500 are on track for modest weekly losses due to lingering AI concerns.
body:
If you read last Friday's blog, you might recall that I had a "higher volatility" outlook for stocks this week, noting several potential market-moving catalysts (most notably earnings from three of the hyperscalers), and the technical setup in the Philadelphia (PHLX) Semiconductor Index (SOX, the index was testing support at the 200-day simple moving average, or SMA, last Friday). This week markets experienced volatility, first on the upside and then on the downside. The SOX bounced from a [...] We are roughly two-thirds of the way through Q3 earnings season and overall, the results are thus far signaling strength. Out of the 301 S&P 500 companies that reported so far, 61% have beat on the top line and 82% have beat on the bottom line. Perhaps more importantly, the year-over-year revenue growth rate has been 13.64% and the earnings-per-share (EPS) growth rate is 29.37%.

## Outlook for Next Week [...] Friday (Nov. 6): Brookfield Asset Management (BAM), Enbridge Inc. (ENB), Humana Inc. (HUM), Moderna Inc. (MRNA), Plains All American Pipeline LP (PAA), PPL Corp. (PPL), Vistra Corp. (VST), Ubiquiti Inc. (UI)
